adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the calendar update path builds `EventManager` with the acting session user (`...user`) and credentials from `getUsersCredentials(ctx.user)`, then calls `eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)`. However, the booking query includes `booking.user.credentials` (organizer credentials) but they are never used. Since the handler explicitly allows non-organizers (team admin/owner, or an attendee) to add guests, those flows will attempt to update the organizer’s external calendar event using the wrong user’s credentials/client, which can lead to no-op updates or incorrect updates.
